source_text: Et adhuc eo loquente, ecce Judas unus ex duodecim venit, et cum eo turba multa cum gladiis et fustibus missi a principibus sacerdotum. Propter multitudinem credentium timuerunt ne raperetur; ego autem existimo eos putasse eum magicis disciplinis posse effugere. Gloria Christo. Amen.
thought_title: Judas arrives with the armed crowd
orientation: Origen is commenting on Matthew 26:47, where Judas arrives with a crowd while Jesus is still speaking.
pass_a_gloss: And still him speaking, behold Judas one from [the] twelve came, and with him crowd much with swords and clubs sent from [the] chiefs of [the] priests. Because of [the] multitude of [the] believing [ones] they feared lest he should be snatched away; I however think them [to] have thought him by magical teachings [to] be able to escape. Glory [to] Christ. Amen.

choices.why: Keeps the adjective-noun order and the sense of a sizeable armed group.
Preserves the passive participle and the agency of the chief priests.
Keeps the passive subjunctive of fear and the sense of forcible taking.
rejected: that he might be snatched away

choices.why: Renders the ablative of means and the sense of learned magical practices.

bible_refs.note: Et adhuc eo loquente, ecce Judas unus ex duodecim venit, et cum eo turba multa cum gladiis et fustibus missi a principibus sacerdotum

pass_b_english: While he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a large crowd with swords and clubs, sent by the chief priests (Matthew 26:47). They feared that because of the multitude of believers he might be seized; but I think they supposed he could escape by magical arts. Glory to Christ. Amen.

last_rejected.quote: They feared that because of the multitude of believers he might be seized
last_rejected.source_quote: Propter multitudinem credentium timuerunt ne raperetur
last_rejected.why: Subject and object reversed: the crowd feared Jesus would be snatched away by believers, not that he would be seized.
last_rejected.fix: They feared that because of the multitude of believers he might be snatched away.
last_rejected.ruling: 'raperetur' = 'be snatched away'; 'propter multitudinem credentium' = by believers. English 'seized' loses the agent and reverses the sense.
